Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a sideswipe collision in League City, Texas, involving two vehicles. According to both
drivers, Driver 2 was changing lanes when the right side of that vehicle contacted the left side of Driver 1's vehicle.
Driver 1 was seated in the vehicle at the time, and I observed Driver 1 at the scene along with a Passenger. Driver 1
reported a wrist fracture and said the impact threw the arm against the door frame. That injury is consistent with the
type and force of the contact. Damage to both vehicles lines up with the described impact. Scene photographs show
some of the reported positions, though no independent witnesses came forward. A few older scratches appear on the
damaged panel, and some may predate this collision. Driver 1 produced insurance documents listing Driver 1 as the
named insured on the policy. Neither driver was cited. Both vehicles were towed from the scene.
